verdict.rationale: Orama's docs state that every Orama Cloud project comes with an MCP server, automatically configured to interact with the project's data. That server is usable from AI interfaces such as ChatGPT and Cursor, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP server docs page exists. This clearly exposes search indexes as an agent tool, but the evidence describes it only as 'interacting with your data'. missing for 10: documented tool list covering query vs. analytics vs. index-management operations, MCP support for the open-source library (evidence is Cloud-only), independent or hands-on corroboration.
